(Translated by Google) I ordered black garlic tonkotsu ramen, edamame, and Sapporo beer at Maki Ramen in Glasgow. Overall, the black garlic tonkotsu ramen exceeded my expectations; the soup had a rich flavor, and I enjoyed the aroma of black garlic. On the other hand, the char siu was just average, and a little on the salty side. The noodles were also slightly different from the noodles you'd find in authentic ramen in Japan, and perhaps they were cooked for a little too short a time. However, this is Glasgow, not Japan. Considering that, I feel like I can't expect anything more. Overall, I'd give the taste about 75 points, and I think it's a perfectly enjoyable place to eat ramen in Glasgow. The edamame was served warm. This is a common style in Europe, so I didn't mind it too much. It paired well with the Sapporo beer. The service was quick, and the staff were friendly. Most of the waitstaff seemed to be local Scots, but the person in charge of sushi appeared to be Japanese or of Asian descent. Overall, it's a place where you can easily enjoy ramen and Japanese food in Glasgow.

グラスゴー市内の Maki Ramen で、黒にんにく豚骨ラーメン、枝豆、サッポロビールを注文しました。黒にんにく豚骨ラーメンは、全体的には期待以上で、スープにはしっかりコクがあり、黒にんにくの香りも楽しめました。一方で、チャーシューは普通という印象で、少し塩気が強めでした。麺も日本で食べる本格的なラーメンの麺とは少し違う感じで、もしかすると茹で時間が少し短かったのかもしれません。ただ、ここは日本ではなくグラスゴー。そう考えると、これ以上何を求めるのか、という気持ちにもなります。全体として味は75点くらいで、グラスゴーでラーメンを食べたい時には十分楽しめるお店だと思います。枝豆は温かい状態で出てきました。ヨーロッパではよくあるスタイルなので、そこはあまり気になりませんでした。サッポロビールとの相性も良かったです。サービスは素早く、スタッフの方々もフレンドリーでした。ホールスタッフは地元スコットランドの方が多い印象でしたが、寿司を担当されている方は日本人、またはアジア系の職人さんのように見えました。全体的に、グラスゴーで気軽にラーメンと日本食を楽しめるお店です。

Traveling to Scotland, and there comes a time when the next meal MUST be Asian noodles or I’ll die. I’m fairly picky about ramen so it’s always a gamble, but this place was great. Got the chicken ramen with a very mildly spiced miso broth. Broth was tasty, but not too rich - I literally finished the entire bowl. Noodles were really interesting, in a good way. They weren’t a classic alkaline springy ramen, BUT they had a nice al dente texture that almost reminded me of soba. Nothing breaks ramen like a soggy sad noodle, and I’m happy to report these noodles passed the test! Service was fast and friendly. Apps were good. And reading everyone’s sticky notes and doodles on the walls was really cute. I’d definitely go back!
